body.voice_description: Create an original voice for an eager puppy chess companion. An adult male voice with a high, light tenor and a thin, small-sounding resonance with almost no chest weight. Excited words tumble out quickly, then he slows down to explain one idea carefully. Earnest, wide-eyed rookie energy rather than a confident adult teacher. No gravel, no mature narrator weight, no cartoon squeak. Fluent English at a normal conversational pace, about eight to ten seconds. Clear words and a fully finished final phrase. Clean dry studio sound, one voice, no music or animal noises. An original fictional adult voice, never an imitation of a named actor or character.
body.text: Oh, there it is! That move leaves a piece with no defender. Let's check the reply together, then try to keep that piece protected.
